query:
SELECT 
  ac.id AS client_id,
  ac.email,
  ac.name,
  ac.is_active AS client_active,
  COUNT(cq.id) AS total_quotas_active
FROM allowed_clients ac
INNER JOIN client_quotas cq ON cq.client_id = ac.id AND cq.is_active = 1
WHERE ac.is_active = 0
GROUP BY ac.id, ac.email, ac.name, ac.is_active
ORDER BY ac.name;
